what: the same card's price per flipped B mantissa bit at 600 MHz (governor pinned by TDP 0)

e60_aifoundry2_800MHz.estimator: h2 -> h8 secant (only lq_h0/h2/h8 were run there: E60 departure D5)

V1.claim: the price per flipped mantissa bit at 600 MHz equals this card's own 800 MHz price times (V600/V800)^2 - the flip's energy follows the voltage, not the clock
V1.quantity: lq h2 -> h8 secant, board, fJ per designed flipped bit
V1.pass_if: measured inside the band AND outside the alternative's own +-10% band

V2.claim: the same on the minion rail
V2.quantity: lq h2 -> h8 secant, minion rail, fJ per designed flipped bit

V3.claim: the watts of each rung scale as f*V^2 (the clock is in the watts, not in the energy): the line through this card's own 800 MHz lq_h2 and lq_h8
V3.pass_if: lq_h2 and lq_h8 inside +-10%; h1 and h4 are reported, not scored (E60 never ran them on this card, so their line is an interpolation)

V4.claim: the ladder is bent the same way as on E60's 600 MHz card: the full h >= 1 slope exceeds the h2 -> h8 secant
V4.pass_if: the ratio is inside the band

V5.claim: the busy ladder lb - which this card cannot run at 800 MHz at all - costs more per bit than lq, by the factor E60 measured at 600 MHz on the other card
V5.quantity: lb full-ladder slope / lq full-ladder slope, board
V5.pass_if: the ratio is inside the band

V6.claim: the turn-on (the first flipped bit, which wakes the multiplier tree) is dearer with a busy partner, by about the factor E60 measured at 600 MHz
V6.quantity: lb_h1 / lq_h1 in watts over their own zeros
V6.pass_if: the ratio is inside the band

G1.claim: the governor is pinned: TDP 0 means the power-down branch fires on any load and the power-up branch can never fire, so the clock never leaves the vmin-LUT floor
G1.quantity: every telemetry sample of every launch, and the governor's own log
G1.predicted: 600 MHz in 100% of samples; zero 'Power throttle up' lines while TDP 0 is set
G1.pass_if: exactly that, with no sample at any other clock

G2.claim: the voltage at the pinned point is the LUT's 600 MHz voltage
G2.pass_if: the mean measured minion voltage is inside the band

G3.claim: restore: both governor fields read back at their originals and the card steps normally afterwards
G3.predicted: TDP 65 W, software threshold 65 C, and a post-restore burst that reaches >= 700 MHz with at least one 'Power throttle up' event

leak_slopes_reported.registered: auto (reduce_hl.py's own within-run fit, as E60 and E68 registered it)
leak_slopes_reported.note: the price is a difference between two rungs in the same pass, so the leakage slope enters only through the small difference in within-run heating between rungs; all three are reported and the registered one is the verdict
